before.label: Model export
before.definition: Converting a framework program into a self-contained deployable artifact by tracing or capturing its graph and fixing operators, shapes, and weights.

fields.definition: Converting a framework model into an artifact with an explicit computation and input contract that a compatible runtime can execute.

changes.rationale: Export can capture a computation with input shape constraints; fixed shapes are not a universal requirement. The correction is editorial synthesis; retained neighboring claims remain provisional.

sources.supports: Export can capture a computation with input shape constraints; fixed shapes are not a universal requirement.

before.label: Accelerator sharing and partitioning
before.definition: Running several workloads on one accelerator by time-slicing, concurrent contexts, or hardware partitions with dedicated memory and compute slices.

changes.rationale: Whole-device pass-through assigns a physical GPU exclusively to one VM; it is not an equivalent name for sharing or partitioning. The correction is editorial synthesis; retained neighboring claims remain provisional.

sources.supports: Whole-device pass-through assigns a physical GPU exclusively to one VM; it is not an equivalent name for sharing or partitioning.

before.label: Conformal prediction
before.definition: Constructing prediction sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees under exchangeability, using held-out calibration scores.

fields.definition: Constructing prediction sets from conformity scores with finite-sample coverage guarantees under stated assumptions, such as exchangeability.

changes.rationale: Split conformal is a special case. Its disjoint calibration requirement does not define all conformal methods, and marginal coverage does not supply arbitrary conditional guarantees. The correction is editorial synthesis; retained neighboring claims remain provisional.

sources.supports: Split conformal is a special case. Its disjoint calibration requirement does not define all conformal methods, and marginal coverage does not supply arbitrary conditional guarantees.

before.label: Modality encoder
before.definition: A network that turns images, audio, or video into token sequences for a shared backbone; visual tokens often dominate prefill cost and KV size.

changes.rationale: A vision encoder produces features that are projected into visual tokens; the tokens are representations, not the encoder. The correction is editorial synthesis; retained neighboring claims remain provisional.

sources.supports: A vision encoder produces features that are projected into visual tokens; the tokens are representations, not the encoder.

before.conditions: Coverage holds marginally under exchangeability between calibration and test data, not under distribution shift.

fields.conditions: Prediction sets inform an abstention rule; ordinary marginal coverage under exchangeability does not automatically guarantee coverage under distribution shift or conditional accuracy among accepted predictions.

changes.rationale: Split conformal is a special case. Its disjoint calibration requirement does not define all conformal methods, and marginal coverage does not supply arbitrary conditional guarantees. The correction is editorial synthesis; retained neighboring claims remain provisional.

sources.supports: Split conformal is a special case. Its disjoint calibration requirement does not define all conformal methods, and marginal coverage does not supply arbitrary conditional guarantees.

before.conditions: Operators, shapes, and weights are fixed so the artifact runs without the original program.

fields.conditions: The artifact represents supported operators, parameters, and input constraints for its target runtime.

changes.rationale: Export can capture a computation with input shape constraints; fixed shapes are not a universal requirement. The correction is editorial synthesis; retained neighboring claims remain provisional.

sources.supports: Export can capture a computation with input shape constraints; fixed shapes are not a universal requirement.

before.conditions: Coverage holds only under exchangeability with that calibration split.

fields.conditions: For split conformal methods, the calibration data are separated from score-function fitting, with the stated exchangeability assumptions required for the coverage guarantee.

changes.rationale: Split conformal is a special case. Its disjoint calibration requirement does not define all conformal methods, and marginal coverage does not supply arbitrary conditional guarantees. The correction is editorial synthesis; retained neighboring claims remain provisional.

sources.supports: Split conformal is a special case. Its disjoint calibration requirement does not define all conformal methods, and marginal coverage does not supply arbitrary conditional guarantees.

before.conditions: Holds with recall loss that grows as code size shrinks.

fields.conditions: Vectors are stored as shorter quantized codes rather than full-precision coordinates; recall depends on quantization, partition probing, reranking, and the data.

changes.rationale: Quantized codes reduce stored vector size; probing and refinement also affect search quality. A universal monotonic recall-loss claim is unwarranted. The correction is editorial synthesis; retained neighboring claims remain provisional.
